thread.title: Magical Girl Raising Project restart • Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku restart - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters considered this one of the strongest episodes so far, especially because the established cast had more room for character interaction.
Pfle and Mamori were repeatedly viewed as entertaining, with their dynamic generating much of the thread’s humor.
Some commenters enjoyed the contrasting team dynamics and found the group interactions engaging.
The episode’s late developments generated strong excitement and shock, though reactions also emphasized how harsh and unsettling they felt.
Some commenters remained frustrated by the game’s management and distrusted the person running it.
Discussion of the large cast and quickly changing circumstances suggested that some viewers found the character relationships compelling while others felt emotional investment was difficult.
